full_name: Korean Realization Calculus v0.1 — Typed Semantic–Discourse State, Licensed Linearization, Model-Mediated Surface Realization & Independent Witness-Based Critique
fundamental_object: Korean whole-passage generation, not PIA/admission/revision consensus. Context-conditioned naturalness and factual fidelity are distinct axes.

mathematical_object.F: Finite set of licensed atomic propositions with local source provenance
mathematical_object.U: Finite set of explicitly unknown predicates, quantities and mental states
mathematical_object.D: Directed acyclic typed discourse graph over F with independently warrantable edges
mathematical_object.C: (genre, addressee, information structure, narrative point-of-view, register, target length)
mathematical_object.L: A typed, two-paragraph linearization plan: ordered slots, each with atom references, rhetorical role, discourse relation and epistemic force
mathematical_object.R: Candidate surface realization preserving F while declining unsupported assertions over U
mathematical_object.V: An independent evidence-based checker, returning hard warnings / unverifiable / descriptive signals, never aesthetic truth
mathematical_object.fiber: R(F,D,C)={r : covers required fact obligations, invents no unsupported assertions, satisfies contextual discourse constraints}; only operationally approximated, NOT fully decidable by regex.
mathematical_object.quality: Naturalness, rhythm, coherence, genre fit and voice form a partial context-dependent order; no scalar learned discriminator is treated as truth.

constraints: Each fact in exactly one primary slot; duplication permitted as discourse paraphrase only in language, not as an extra event.
No ASSERTED_CAUSE edge without a distinct warrant beyond temporal/experimental order.
Every paragraph has at least one slot and there are exactly two paragraphs.
Each slot's fact ids must resolve to the same brief and cannot reference unknowns as facts.
Genre-specific sequencing does not assert unobserved mental states or third-party motives.
K plan is generated by deterministic compiler, not a model-produced plan or post-result manual tuning.

generation.seed_by_brief: 6400+brief_index, same seed across B/A/K of same brief
generation.output: Plain Korean passage, exactly two paragraphs requested, 240–400 chars target but noncompliance retained
generation.system_prompt_condition: Same foundational instruction and factual input for all arms; A adds surface-only constraints; K adds compiled typed linearization IR; instruction/token budget DIFFERENCES are not controlled out.
generation.effective_variables: Joint typed-plan-plus-prompt intervention versus generic model and word-ban ablation; cannot attribute all effect to graph formalism alone.

evaluation.mechanical_critic: Separate deterministic code run on raw output plus immutable factual briefs
evaluation.blind_reader_packet: Opaque documents, arm info absent, randomized order
evaluation.human_review: Not performed by CI; reader naturalness/appropriateness and separate semantic review required
evaluation.primary_estimand: Within-brief blinded reader preference K versus B
evaluation.statistics: No significance without human participants, no auto-score equals human judgment

experimental_protocol.source_rights: All six briefs are internally authored fictional teaching scenarios, not PIA, personal writing or licensed third-party text.
experimental_protocol.stop: One complete 18-output run, no prompt tuning on these briefs, no automatic generator->critic optimization on trial outcomes, archive outcome/failure types as-is.
